records.note: Faits publics exacts mais objet d'une seule ligne, aucune date d'execution et signature remontant au 11/03/2026 ; surtout l'adjudicataire est un Totaluebernehmer (societe de services, de promotion et de financement) qui attribue des lots au lieu d'acheter des materiaux, si bien que la correspondance avec un negoce reste nominale.

Works lot (CPV 45421000) for installing ~280 interior/fire-rated door elements: the installer must source those components upstream, so the materials need holds, but whether a general building-materials merchant is the realistic channel for EI30/EI90 door sets needs checking.

Well-described 11.5 MEUR new-build car park (approx. 1000 spaces, two-year duration, named branch and locality) awarded five weeks ago, so the why-now holds; the open question is whether a vertically integrated systems builder like GOLDBECK buys through an external materials merchant at all.

Real DE construction award with itemised quantities (265 curtain-wall units, 1600 m of sills) and a firm 08.02.2027 start, but a curtain-wall specialist buys mainly from system houses rather than a general materials merchant, and the equipment need's stated rationale ('earthworks or civil engineering') plainly misreads a facade metalwork job - a rep must verify before calling.

Screed works (CPV 45262320/45262321, EUR 629,733, Dec 2026-Nov 2027) is a materials-heavy trade squarely in the ICP's core, but the notice publishes no bill of quantities and the co-derived equipment rationale wrongly describes the lot as earthworks/civil engineering, so a short check is needed before contact.

A EUR 5.2M phase-one park and road works contract in Castellon signed five days ago, matched to a materials merchant that actually sells in Spain, with earthworks and landscaping CPVs that make the plant and materials needs land squarely; the only homework is deciding which of the two joint-venture entities to call.

The scope is HVAC plant (AHU, spiral duct, fire dampers, volume controllers) bought from ventilation wholesale rather than a building-materials merchant, only a few hundred m2 of insulation is addressable on a 216k EUR job, and the place fields are inverted (locality '72622', postal_code 'Nurtingen').

A 504k EUR PV installation whose notice lists the full bill of materials makes component procurement genuinely credible in-territory, but the big-ticket items (1304 modules, 5 inverters, battery) come from PV distribution rather than a general building-materials merchant, so a rep should check catalogue overlap before calling.

A 201755 EUR interior-plastering lot in a Muhlhausen hospital with a published execution window (2026-08-03 to 2027-02-12) genuinely consumes plaster and finishing materials, which is exactly the ICP's primary offer in an in-territory country; the equipment need's rationale ('terrassement ou genie civil') is however contradicted by the published object and would not survive a reading of the title, which keeps this a lead to verify rather than a clean contact.

Regional contractor 10 km from site won a 1.02M EUR earthworks/special-foundation/shell package in Aalen starting 31 Aug 2026, which is exactly the concrete, rebar, formwork and aggregate spend a euro-zone materials merchant sells.

Public-lighting works for the Caen tramway consume columns, luminaires, control cabinets and cable bought through electrical wholesale by two national group subsidiaries with framework purchasing, leaving only marginal ducting/concrete for a building-materials merchant.

The published scope is specialist pipe-jacking under the A63 (sheet-pile shaft, soil nails, 100 m DN800 steel casing) whose inputs come from steel and shoring specialists, and Eiffage Route Sud-Ouest procures through its own group, so the generic materials need maps poorly onto this ICP.

Tramway overhead contact line works are supplied by specialist rail-electrification manufacturers to a VINCI rail subsidiary; apart from mast foundation concrete there is no coherent building-materials pitch behind this 5.15M EUR award.

Published quantities (1800 m2 of 35 cm crushed-stone base, 1200 m3 backfill, 200 m DN110-160 pipe, PE DN400 chambers) on a 331k EUR excavation lot starting 1 Sep 2026 are straight merchant goods with a two-week window to act.

2,39 MEUR de travaux de sécurité routière au Portugal remportés par une PME régionale, signés le 30/07 pour 180 jours : un négoce matériaux zone euro a une raison légitime d'appeler, mais la nature routière des fournitures (enrobés, glissières, signalisation) demande une vérification de gamme avant contact.

Excellent ancrage commercial (50 000 m de câble, 500 luminaires, tableaux BT, chantier démarré le 03/08 sur deux ans à Maintal) et besoin d'approvisionnement crédible pour un installateur électrique, mais les composants sont du ressort d'un grossiste électrique plus que d'un négoce de matériaux de construction : fit à vérifier.

A 2.98 MEUR new-build incubator in Cadiz awarded 2026-07-16 and signed 2026-08-13 is a textbook materials-consuming works contract inside the ICP territory, but no execution date is published and nothing shows whether the winner self-performs or subcontracts the shell, so a short verification precedes contact.

Aménagement routier de 1,11 MEUR à Saragosse signé le 13/08 par une UTE régionale : piste commerciale saine, mais l'interlocuteur est un groupement momentané (deux NIF, aucun membre nommé) et les fournitures routières demandent une vérification de gamme.

Chantier de renforcement de chaussée de 379 kEUR et 10 jours seulement, attribué le 16/06 à une filiale d'Eiffage Route qui produit ses propres enrobés et achète en centrale groupe : correspondance nominale, valeur commerciale quasi nulle et travaux vraisemblablement déjà terminés à la date de publication.

Réhabilitation d'ouvrage sur l'A63 très bien décrite (100 m de coques PRV Ø1200, injection de vide annulaire, 420 m3 de terrassement, 45 m3 d'enrochements bétonnés, 6 mois depuis le 03/08) : les fournitures spécialisées ne sont pas produites par le gagnant, mais l'achat passera probablement par la centrale Eiffage.

Lot distinct du même avis, 637 kEUR d'aménagement routier remportés par une PME d'excavation aragonaise signant le 13/08 : profil d'acheteur réellement approvisionnable, sous réserve de vérifier que la gamme couvre bien les fournitures de voirie.

Best-anchored signal of the batch: named DE joinery firm, 5.2 MEUR of doors/fitted furniture/cladding with a full bill of quantities, execution starting in ten weeks - a materials merchant knows exactly what to pitch and when.

Winner, CHF 909'846.35 and Wadenswil ZH check out, but the published object field is a blank form header ('WEGLEITUNG INHALT UND ECKDATEN') displayed as 'objet publie', so the workforce/PPE needs rest on contract_type plus amount alone, and the award decision is 147 days old against a 7-day-old notice.

Named Swiss PV installer, CHF 2.7M in-roof photovoltaic lot on a cantonal school in Aargau with a fresh publication, so labour capacity and site PPE are defensible hooks for a construction-inputs supplier, but the need wording is boilerplate and the award is three months old, so a rep should verify mobilisation status before pitching.

EUR 577k interior-door joinery lot in Tubingen with a full door schedule and a defined 2027-01-18 to 2027-06-15 window is a solid in-territory lead, but the buying window is five months out and the input mix is specialist joinery rather than the broad site inputs this ICP sells.

A EUR 182k / 24-month green-waste storage and recovery service at an existing Italian treatment site is matched to a multi-country supplier of construction-site inputs on a bare 'won a contract so will need people' workforce inference, so the category coincides but the commercial reality does not.

Fresh CHF 263k bituminous surfacing lot in Valais with published tonnages is a usable lead, but extra labour and PPE are routine for a public-works contractor at this size and the obvious materials angle (880 t of mix) is not among the derived needs.

CHF 474k of painting and plastering on a roof and facade renovation in Zurich, awarded four days before publication, gives a direct paint/render materials and crew-capacity pitch to a named, addressable winner.

The plant-hire need is justified by earthworks and civil engineering on a lot that is explicitly BKP 272.0 metal interior doors, a rationale the published object contradicts and that would point a rep at the wrong conversation, even though the labour and steel-input angles hold.

A 400k CHF Spengler and flat-roof package in Embrach is a real materials lead for a broad construction-inputs supplier and the contract object is precisely displayed, but the equipment need's justification claims the works are 'terrassement ou genie civil' which flatly contradicts the roofing description shown in the same signal and is feed noise that should be cleaned.

The published object is unusually well quantified (455 m section, 1760 t of bituminous mixes, 370 ml of kerbs) and fully supports both the workforce and the site-safety inferences for a 751k CHF road reconstruction in Valais, all facts traceable to the cited SIMAP publication.

EUR 1.11M road-conditioning award in Zaragoza province matches aggregates, plant and crew supply well, but the winner is an unresolved UTE (two tax IDs, no street address) so the rep must identify the actual member firms before contact.

An 810k CHF pool-lining and whirlpool package is materially intensive so the materials need holds, but pool linings are a niche trade supplied by specialist manufacturers rather than a broad 'intrants de chantier' group, and the equipment need again invokes earthworks that this contract does not involve.

A CHF 3.07M timber assembly, facade, window and sun-protection lot for SBB awarded twelve days ago is a real materials and labour consumer in a covered territory, so it belongs in the feed, but one derived need justifies itself by calling the works earthworks or civil engineering when they are carpentry and building envelope, which a rep must ignore.

The workforce need is genuinely credible - 120,000 m2/month of office cleaning over 12 months is as labour-intensive as it gets - but routing an office facility-cleaning contractor in Berlin to an ICP that sells 'intrants de chantier' is a bare category-name collision on workforce_capacity: a construction-inputs group has no coherent offer for a cleaning firm's staffing.

The award is precisely for designing and erecting temporary site container facilities, so 'temporary site equipment or plant capacity' is the winner's own deliverable rather than a downstream need, and the supporting rationale invents earthworks and civil engineering works that the published object excludes.

A 'Lieferung und Montage' PV contract of min 410 kWp delivered and ~830 kWp integrated 'inkl. Fremdlieferungen' is explicit that the winner will procure third-party components, which makes the materials need credible upstream rather than a deliverable confusion; the open dimension is whether a generalist inputs group carries PV mounting, cabling and module ranges, and the earthworks rationale on the equipment need is again wrong.

At 118k CHF for roughly 240 t of asphalt and 200 t of milling on a mountain road, this is a few days' routine work, and the needs are derived from contract_type and amount alone - the description is not even in the evidence set - so the signal reduces to 'a road contractor won a small job, therefore people and PPE', which is exactly the generic case that does not earn a feed slot.

Notice enumerates 50'000 m of cable, 500 luminaires and switchgear for EUR 1'596'388.37 over a 737-day span, which anchors the materials need concretely; the published start (2026-08-03) precedes the signature (2026-08-10), so the 'immediate' why-now rests on an internally inconsistent date pair.

EUR 5.2M joinery package in Munich with itemised quantities (731 door frames, 299 built-in units, 5,485 m of skirting) and a 2026-10-28 start hits the ideal ten-week procurement window for both materials and installation capacity.

A five-year hospital portering and grounds-maintenance contract in Messina is read as a transport market needing extra rolling stock, and while the labour-capacity angle is genuinely strong for a service that is almost pure headcount, a supplier of construction-site inputs has little to sell here so the lead does not earn feed space.

CHF 1.7M of electrical installation across six construction phases on a prison entrance zone, awarded seven days ago in Zurich, is trade work that genuinely draws site labour and PPE, so it is a fair call for a construction-inputs supplier once the rep checks whether a Swisscom-scale contractor actually buys capacity externally.

Phased CHF 2.5M tram siding civil works in Geneva beside live overhead contact lines make site labour and protective equipment genuinely credible, but the engine oddly omitted plant hire and materials on the one contract in the batch that is unambiguously earthworks, so the hook is thinner than the project deserves.

The largest Swiss award in the batch at CHF 6.25M of facade construction makes working-at-height protection and erection labour genuinely credible, but the engine derived no materials or components need on a contract that is literally envelope supply and install, and the May award date weakens the why-now.

Generic building-site labour and PPE needs fired off a CPV 45000000 code when the published object is servers, cameras, radar, lidar and intercom hardware installed by certified technicians, so a supplier of construction-site inputs is chasing a security-systems integrator that buys almost none of what it sells.

Winner, 8.29M CHF amount, CPV 45000000 and the published bill of quantities all check out against the SIMAP record, and a labour/materials ramp on a road-and-drainage job of this scale is a sound inference for a CH construction-inputs supplier, but Cellere Bau AG is a large incumbent with existing supply channels so a short verification is needed before contact.

Drivers and fleet are genuine inputs for a 2 MEUR non-medical passenger transport contract in Badajoz, but an ICP whose offer is explicitly construction site inputs has no real commercial angle on a Spanish transport operator, so the match is nominal on the category label only.

CHF 1'133'321.95 of road restructuring with 1'735 m3 of trenching makes collective protection and PPE better founded than the batch template usually is, but place of performance is left at country level and the 970 t of asphalt and gravel in the notice produced no materials need.

An EUR 11'555'000 design-and-build car park of about 1'000 spaces, awarded 2026-07-13 and signed 2026-07-24 with a two-year duration, carries all three needs credibly, but no execution date is published and the awardee is a branch of a vertically integrated systems builder, so the buying entity and window need verifying first.

Fresh CHF 489k steel assembly lot on the Embrach pool conversion is a real lead, but the one-line object gives little to pitch on and the earthworks wording behind the plant-hire need sits awkwardly with steel erection.

Chantier d'enrobés suisse de 417 kCHF avec quantités chiffrées et fenêtre d'exécution 14.09–23.10.2026 : bon lead, mais le nom du gagnant est affiché corrompu (« DE_Foser AG ») et le besoin matériaux n'est pas dérivé alors que 930 t + 660 t d'enrobé et 780 m3 de fondation sont publiés.

Adjudication fraîche (10.08.2026) de 524 kCHF sur une centrale de froid à Berne, objet bien décrit, mais les seuls besoins retenus (personnel, EPI) sont les plus faibles pour un installateur frigorifique spécialisé alors que composants et matériaux auraient porté le fit.

Menuisier allemand, aménagement d'école à Wiesbaden avec métré détaillé (panneaux HPL, lambris acoustiques, portes, appareils) et exécution du 28.08 au 05.10.2026 : le besoin matériaux est directement ancré dans l'objet publié et le commercial peut appeler aujourd'hui avec un argumentaire précis.

Eiffage Route Nord Est est un routier de tier 1 intégré verticalement (enrobés et parc d'engins en propre, achats en accords-cadres groupe) et le marché ne dure que 10 jours pour une signature du 08.07.2026 : proposer personnel, engins et matériaux sur cette base est du bruit pour mon équipe.

Service triennal d'entretien communal en Pouilles (~140 k EUR/an, espaces verts, voirie, assistance aux manifestations) réduit à un besoin de personnel générique : coïncidence nominale de catégorie, aucune réalité commerciale pour un groupe d'intrants de chantier.

Malgré un gagnant tier 1, le chantier est atypique et vivant (signature 03.08.2026, 6 mois, dérivation de cours d'eau avec batardeaux et pompage, installation et clôtures de chantier, enrochements) : la location et les intrants de site restent réellement externalisés, une vérification suffit avant contact.

Adjudication suisse fraîche de 618 kCHF en travaux de jardinier (BKP 421) : lead correct, mais le justificatif « terrassement ou génie civil » de la ligne engins ne correspond pas à l'objet publié et l'objet lui-même tient en deux lignes.

Coopérative sociale italienne d'entretien d'espaces verts (48 mois, Trévise) : son modèle repose sur l'emploi de ses propres travailleurs, donc lui vendre de la capacité de personnel est commercialement bancal, et le montant est en outre affiché avec quatre décimales (895984,4625 EUR).

Réfection de chaussée cantonale tessinoise de 868 kCHF avec pose de couche d'usure de nuit et par étapes : besoins matériaux, engins et personnel réellement crédibles, mais la décision date du 29.04.2026 sans date d'exécution publiée, donc une vérification de planning s'impose avant appel.

HELLA Storen AG est un fabricant de protection solaire livrant son propre produit et les seuls besoins retenus (personnel, EPI) sortent du seul couple type de contrat + montant, sans aucun ancrage : « a gagné un marché, aura donc besoin de ressources », avec en prime l'acheteur affiché deux fois.

Travaux de plâtrerie de 366 kCHF à Zollikon (isolations intérieures, cloisons et plafonds en plaques, enduits) adjugés le 03.08.2026 : besoin matériaux très bien ancré, mais aucune date d'exécution et le justificatif « terrassement ou génie civil » de la ligne engins est faux pour ce corps de métier.

Installations sanitaires de 847 kCHF sur la rénovation de la piscine d'Embrach, adjugées le 06.08.2026 : volume de composants réel, mais canal d'achat spécialisé à vérifier pour un fournisseur généraliste et la justification « terrassement ou génie civil » de la ligne engins ne colle pas au BKP 250.

A CHF 618k landscaping refurbishment lot (BKP 421 Gaertnerarbeiten) for the City of Zurich building authority is a legitimate mini-excavator/soil-handling lead, but the boilerplate rationale calls it civil engineering and no site locality is published, so a rep must verify before calling.

The awarded lot is BKP 244/246 ventilation and refrigeration plant, not earthworks; a one-off crane lift for air-handling units is the only realistic hook, so the rationale asserting 'terrassement ou genie civil' is disconnected from the lot and the lead is feed noise for an excavator renter.

Le raisonnement affiche des travaux de terrassement ou de génie civil pour un lot de menuiseries intérieures (94 portes, parois vitrées EI30) : aucun fait publié ne porte un besoin d'engins de terrassement et la preuve contredit la caractérisation présentée.

Shell and structural works (BKP 221 Baumeisterarbeiten) worth CHF 1.28m at a named site in Embrach ZH awarded eleven days ago is exactly the lead my team should call today, though the published lot reference '211' in the title versus 'BKP 221' in the description is a source inconsistency worth flagging.

The published object explicitly covers all Baumeisterarbeiten for a new pumping station including the required Erdarbeiten plus utility and road works at Spiez BE for CHF 1.24m, giving a plant hire rep a concrete, well-timed and well-located reason to prospect.

Le raisonnement invoque terrassement et génie civil pour un lot de portes intérieures en métal : le besoin d'engins de chantier n'est porté par aucun fait publié et orienterait un loueur d'engins vers une fausse piste.

The award is a BKP 275 locking-systems package for a school rebuild, yet the signal justifies an excavator/crane hire need by asserting the works are earthworks or civil engineering, which the published object flatly contradicts, leaving a plant-hire ICP no coherent reason to call.

BKP 359 pool water treatment technology at CHF 1.95m is a specialist mechanical installation where at best a single crane lift for filter vessels applies, so the category match is nominal and the earthworks rationale is simply wrong for this lot.

A CHF 3.07m timber assembly, facade and window package for SBB at Olten SO won by a Grindelwald contractor working far from base is a genuine crane and lifting opportunity, but the stated rationale describes earthworks rather than Montagebau Holz so the rep must reframe before contact.

The reasoning wrongly casts a BKP 250 sanitary package as earthworks, but lifting and site-equipment hire on an active pool-complex conversion remains conceivable, so the lead is weak and boilerplate rather than false.

Pool lining and a whirlpool do involve lifting on a live refurbishment site so crane hire is not absurd, but the stated earthworks justification does not match the package and the need text is pure boilerplate.

An electrical-installation package on the same pool conversion gives a plant-hire ICP only a nominal reason to call, and the earthworks reasoning attached to it is not supported by the published object.

Road-pavement rehabilitation in Ticino is the one record where the machinery need is genuinely credible, but the award was decided on 2026-04-29, 110 days ago against the plant-hire ICP's 60-day ceiling, so the commercial moment has passed.

A CHF 1.2m reservoir replacement at Gadmen BE with a 3 to 9 m deep excavation pit, a soil-nail wall, a temporary construction piste and pipeline replacement in a remote mountain location is the strongest lead in the batch for excavator and haulage hire.

A CHF 183k indoor lab-gas piping lot run by a small specialist MEP firm implies no incremental PPE purchase worth a rep's time; the boilerplate need sentence is attached without any scaling to crew intensity.

Best-anchored signal of the batch — a 39-day asphalt campaign starting 2026-09-14 with published tonnages is a textbook high-vis and traffic-protection window — but the displayed winner name 'DE_Foser AG' carries a TED language prefix, so the rep must resolve the real company before contact.

CHF 524k chiller replacement in a basement plant room with a natural refrigerant is a legitimate B-list lead, but the signal misses the one angle that would sell (confined-space and refrigerant-detection equipment) and offers only the generic site-PPE sentence.

A CHF 4.5M Baumeister lot beside a live railway with a 125m retaining wall is a strong safety-equipment prospect, but execution is stated for 2027-2028 and the winner name 'DE_C. Vanoli AG' carries a TED prefix, so verification precedes contact.

The published facts are accurate, but a CHF 158k resurfacing lot barely clearing the value floor, awarded to a unit of a large national construction group and shown with the buyer duplicated, carries no commercial trigger beyond "a contract was won".

The published object is a SCADA and supervisory software replacement running virtually on existing central IT infrastructure with staged migration, yet the signal treats the buyer's CPV 45000000 as a construction site and derives a PPE supply need from a 'chantier soumis aux obligations de securite' that the object itself excludes, sending a Swiss PPE supplier after a software project.

CHF 1.27M of plastering, drywall and interior render awarded eleven days ago at a named site is a sustained, dust-heavy, labour-intensive trade — a clear reason to call about respiratory and consumable PPE without further checking.

CHF 462k of timber facade cladding is genuine work-at-height with cutting dust, but the description is almost entirely masterplan background rather than the lot scope and the winner name 'DE_Mosimann Holzbau AG' carries a TED prefix.

A CHF 432k heating-installation lot in Geneva is a defensible lead, but the winner is a branch of a large building-technology group with its own supply chain, the name carries an 'FR_' prefix and the locality is misspelt 'Collonge-Belllerive'.

A CHF 446k lift lot won by a global lift manufacturer with centralised procurement gives a Swiss PPE distributor no entry point; the category matches, the commercial reality does not, and the description is only the title repeated.

Insulation and firestopping does drive respiratory protection, but at CHF 146k this is the smallest lot in the batch and barely clears the ICP floor — feed noise for an established insulation contractor with standing supply.

Lot d'échafaudages de 779 kCHF sur une école cantonale à Stein (AG), adjugé dans la fenêtre de 180 jours de l'ICP : un fournisseur EPI suisse a une raison cohérente d'investiguer, sous réserve de vérifier que la montée en charge n'est pas déjà passée.

CHF 4.29M bridge demolition and steel-composite rebuild over live SBB tracks, under high-voltage lines and beside catenary is the strongest safety-equipment context in the batch and the winner is cleanly identified.

A CHF 244k commercial-refrigeration lot with a description that merely repeats the title carries nothing beyond 'this firm won something', and a specialist HVAC installer of that size implies no incremental protective-equipment purchase.

An 8.3 MCHF Swiss road and drainage job with 10'840 m3 of trench excavation and 3 m deep basins is exactly the kind of long, crew-heavy site a PPE and collective-protection supplier should be calling on, but the need text is boilerplate so a rep still needs one verification call before pitching.

Very fresh award (2 days) for joint repair under live vehicle-testing operations with high-pressure water jetting and a noise-protection scaffold, all genuinely PPE-intensive, but Implenia is a national group buying PPE on framework so a 590 kCHF lot is a lead, not a trigger.

A 2.5 MCHF phased tram-track job in Geneva executed alongside live tramway, bus and pedestrian traffic is a credible site-safety opportunity for a regional contractor, though the 2026-04-22 decision means the rep must first check how far execution has progressed.

The stated rationale rests on scale and ramp-up, but a 266 kCHF bus-stop upgrade of 300 m3 gravel and 220 t asphalt is routine work an established civil contractor covers with existing kit, so this is feed noise rather than a reason to call.

A 263 kCHF single-trade resurfacing lot over 1'966 m is a few weeks of work for a paving specialist that already owns its high-visibility and heat-protection gear, and the displayed object text is quoted without a matching description evidence reference.

A 200 kCHF interior fit-out lot barely above the ICP threshold, won by one of the largest Swiss contractor groups, is a nominal category match only: the indoor demolition and coring does involve dust and hearing protection, but nothing here is a purchasing event.

677 kCHF of road adaptation with 504 m3 of utility trenching, infiltration basins and 1'306 t of asphalt over a 710 m section under traffic gives a mid-size Valais contractor a real multi-month site, which is a legitimate lead for edge protection and high-visibility gear.

Award published one day after decision for 7'000 m2 of facade and 50'000 m2 of interior coating work, a trade that consumes respiratory, glove and coverall PPE continuously and needs facade access protection, so this is a well-timed lead worth a qualification call.

The geothermal drilling work is a credible PPE context, but the winner is displayed as "FR_Augsburger Géothermie SA" with a corrupted language prefix that reads as a French entity, alongside a misspelt locality and a missing award date, so a rep searching that name loses time before reaching the right company.

1.07 MCHF of urban underground utility works on a named Basel street section, won by a mid-size regional contractor, is a realistic account for trench shoring, edge protection and high-visibility equipment, even though the published object gives no quantities.

A 3.2 MCHF SBB slope and track stabilisation awarded five days ago, with the winner explicitly coordinating third-party contractors on a live rail corridor, is the highest-intensity safety context in the batch; only the missing canton and locality force a quick lookup.

A 2.7 MCHF in-roof photovoltaic installation on a new school building means months of work at height, which maps directly onto fall arrest and collective roof-edge protection; the 2026-05-07 decision is still inside the 180-day policy but warrants a start-date check.

The published object is only the boilerplate header "WEGLEITUNG INHALT UND ECKDATEN" and the title is a bare cost-code label, so the card tells a rep nothing beyond "an electrical firm won 910 kCHF", and the decision is already 147 days old with no operational date.

Winner, 1'133'321.95 CHF and 2026-07-22 award all trace to the cited SIMAP notice, and a published road restructuring with 1'735 m3 of trenching and 3'500 m2 of demolition genuinely supports an inferred PPE and collective-protection need at a Valais civil works contractor, though the statement stays boilerplate and incumbency remains unverified.

A 143k CHF photovoltaic equipment lot carries only a small install crew, the generic construction-site PPE need adds little, the summary describes the whole renovation rather than the awarded lot, and the winner is displayed with a corrupted 'FR_' name prefix.

Facts are exact and fresh, but the object is supply, installation and commissioning of a video surveillance and intercom system, read as a construction site ramp-up on the strength of CPV 45000000 alone, so the site-PPE premise fits a systems integrator only nominally.

Credible building-site lead signed three days ago with a known Geneva contractor, but the awarded lot's own scope is never described (only the overall project) and the winner name carries a corrupted 'FR_' prefix, so a rep must verify before pitching.

A 6.25 MCHF facade contract is prime fall-protection and PPE territory, but the award dates from early May and only surfaced in August, so mobilisation may already be done and the 'why now' needs checking.

The published description is a form heading ('WEGLEITUNG INHALT UND ECKDATEN') with no scope at all, so the card reduces to 'a plumbing firm won 620k three months ago and will therefore need resources' - nothing for a rep to open with.
Same empty description, same winner, same site and buyer as the sanitary lot but only 249k - a duplicate low-value card that would clutter the feed rather than add a lead.

A sun-shading manufacturer delivering and fitting its own product consumes far less site PPE than the generic construction-site need assumes, and the award is nearly four months old with no operational date.

Published quantities for a 455 m road restructuring with retaining wall, trenching and 4'000 m2 of subgrade work at a declared public works contractor make the PPE and collective-protection inference stand on its own, subject to a check on existing supply arrangements.
A 117k CHF resurfacing job barely above the ICP's value floor - a handful of tonnes of asphalt and a small crew, technically a construction site but not worth a rep's time.
Fresh 2.04 MCHF labour-intensive electrical fit-out of a cantonal laboratory running to 2028 with a well described scope; a strong account to approach once we check whether ETAVIS buys PPE centrally.

Fresh 1.71 MCHF multi-phase electrical installation on a prison site is a real on-site workforce, but cablex is a large national player likely under framework supply, so qualification comes before any pitch.

The published object includes lead remediation of a 300 m shooting range plus wall replacement and slope stabilisation for 1'108'464.85 CHF, which is the batch's most substantive support for a PPE need, yet the signal never surfaces that hazardous-substance detail and stays generic.

A 4.3 MCHF composite arch bridge over live SBB tracks with prefabricated steel lifted in night closure windows is genuinely multi-specialty work, so an outside technical specialist has a real reason to call, but the signal never names which specialty it should pitch.

A 16,6 MCHF Generalplaner mandate won by an architecture practice necessarily spans disciplines the winner does not itself hold, which is the opposite of the winner-is-already-the-provider trap, but Swiss GP teams are normally constituted at bid time so the commercial window at award publication requires verification before contact.
